description_en: Deletes an entity from the specified custom recognition library
description_zh: 从指定的自定义识别库中删除一个已存在的识别实体
name: DeleteRecognitionEntity

parameters.description_en:
The type of recognition algorithm associated with the entity. Valid values:

- landmark

- object

- logo

- face

- label

- logo：自定义logo

- face：自定义人脸

- label：自定义标签
